comments.author: @ajitkumarp1026

comments.text:
In a health insurance policy, the company will pay for the "expenses" to the hospital. In a critical illness policy, the company directly pays to the insurer, which can utilise as per his/her will. 

In my opinion, one should have both insurance policies. If I have both and if I am diagnosed with a critical illness, I get the insurance amount in my bank account. I can utilise it for paying off my debts or use it as an emergency fund, because I can't go to work for a period of time. Also I can use the health insurance policy for the treatment expenses.

I think it's how it works

comments.text:
Around 3 year before I ported my Medical Insurance from HDFC ERGO to NIVA BUPA  directly from website.I was hospitalised in one of hospital in Ahmedabad City between 23-28 Aug 2023.
Registered my claim of Rs.30480/- on Niva Bupa App on 20 Sept 2023.
My cliam ID was 1485400.
Quarry regarding Additional Information Raised by NiVA on 30 Sept 2023.
I submitted additional documents to Niva on 14 Oct 2023.
There was call from Niva Team that everything is OK with submitted documents but there is mismatch in my Residencial Address for which 3rd Party inspection team will come to my present address for verification.
(Reason for mismatch was that my relative who admitted me to hospital written his own Address & due weakness during discharge I forgotten to correct it.)
On 31st Oct 2023 Representative of 3rd Party came to my Office instead of my residence given me a form to fillup. That form was full of Medical terminology so I told him that I have already submitted my documents to NIVA during registration you can do that Verification from that documents or from hospital end.Also tried to clear him that this Verification is regarding address issue but however I cooperated him given necessary information.
On 10 Dec. 2023 Documents submitted by 3rd Party to NIVA BuPA & again evaluation started by them.
On 19th Dec. 2023 NIVA team rejected my claim on behalf of "Incorporation from Customer End".
I was shocked by that reason again contacted  Customer Care of NIVA Bupa they suggest me to raise request to reopen my case .
On 18 Jan 2024 mailed NIVA BuPA to reopen my case.
They reopened my case & mailed me on 20th Jan 2024 to sent all original hospital documents to their Claim Department in Noida.
On 24th Jan 2024 I sent all required documents to Noida Address.
On 25 Jan 2024 Representative of 3rd party visited my home. This time I again filled up full form also given all asked informations to him.(I have scaned copy of that form)
I was tracking my claim regularly on Customer Care End & unfortunately got message on 20 Fab 2024 that my claim rejected on previous reason of Noncorpration from Customer End.
Now I am contacting to Customer Care they suggesting me to raise request to reopen case again.
Just for Address Correction NIVA BuPA herassment with me.
Please help me out in my case.
Othervise I will port my policy to other company.
